// Scratch generator of investment-treemap.json, not built by this repo. From a detached acr worktree
// at the producer commit, with the selector flag on, then `go run ./cmd/zztreemap <this directory>`.

// internal/contextfabric/zz_treemap_export.go
package contextfabric

import (
	"time"

	contractsv1 "github.com/full-chaos/dev-health-acr/internal/contracts/v1"
)

// Scratch only (CHAOS-12496), never committed: a full result through the real selector, flag on.
func ZZTreemapResult(shares []float64) InvestigationResult {
	tokens := []string{ThemeFeatureDelivery, ThemeOperational, ThemeMaintenance, ThemeQuality, ThemeRisk}
	rows := make([]ClaimedFactRow, 0, len(shares))
	for index, share := range shares {
		value, effort, theme := share, share*120, tokens[index]
		source, attribution := "work_unit_investments", "owned_repository"
		rows = append(rows, ClaimedFactRow{Fields: map[string]ScalarValue{
			"theme": {String: &theme}, "share": {Number: &value}, "weighted_effort": {Number: &effort},
			"source": {String: &source}, "attribution": {String: &attribution},
		}})
	}
	basis := "work_unit_investments"
	repository := SubjectRef{Kind: contractsv1.ContextFabricSubjectRepository, CanonicalID: "repository:full-chaos/dev-health-web", Label: "full-chaos/dev-health-web"}
	result := InvestigationResult{
		SchemaVersion: InvestigationResultSchemaV1, ResultID: "result_treemap_0001", RequestID: "request_treemap_0001",
		GeneratedAt: time.Date(2026, 11, 1, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), Status: InvestigationComplete,
		Question: "Where is effort going in full-chaos/dev-health-web?",
		Interpretation: InterpretedQuestion{
			Shape: ShapeSingleSubject, RequestedJudgment: "allocation",
			TimeContext:      TimeContext{Axis: TemporalCurrent},
			FactRequirements: []FactRequirement{{Kind: FactInvestment}},
		},
		SubjectResolution:   SubjectResolution{Candidates: []SubjectCandidate{}, Committed: []SubjectRef{repository}},
		DirectJudgment:      "Effort leans to feature delivery.",
		CurrentState:        "Most effort appears to go to feature delivery.",
		StrongestPressures:  []string{},
		Drivers:             []DriverJudgment{},
		RemainingWork:       []Finding{},
		ReadinessGaps:       []Finding{},
		Paths:               []RelationshipPath{},
		Conflicts:           []Finding{},
		Limitations:         []string{},
		EvidenceRefIDs:      []string{},
		Coverage:            Coverage{Sources: []SourceObservation{}, DegradedReasons: []string{}},
		Versions:            VersionSet{ServiceVersion: "test-v1", ContractVersion: InvestigationResultSchemaV1, Backend: "test"},
		DeterministicAnswer: "Effort leans to feature delivery in this window.",
		Warnings:            []string{},
		AnswerPlan: &contractsv1.ContextFabricAnswerPlan{
			Family: QuestionFamilyInvestmentAllocation, FamilyVersion: QuestionFamilyTableVersion,
			FamilySource: contractsv1.ContextFabricQuestionFamilySourceModel, Budget: contractsv1.ContextFabricAnswerPlanBudget{MaxItems: 400, MaxSerializedBytes: 262144, MaxMembers: 1, SynthesisHeadroom: 40},
			RenderKinds: []contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderKind{contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderKindTreemap, contractsv1.ContextFabricRenderKindTable},
		},
		ClaimedFacts: []ClaimedFact{{
			ClaimID: "claim_investment_web", Kind: FactInvestment, Field: "attribution_basis", Value: ScalarValue{String: &basis}, Rows: rows, Subject: repository,
			Table: &contractsv1.ContextFabricClaimedFactTable{
				Field: "theme_breakdown", Shape: contractsv1.ContextFabricFactTableShapeBreakdown, Key: []string{"theme"},
				Measures: []string{"share", "weighted_effort"}, Observations: []string{"source", "attribution"},
			},
		}},
	}
	result.RenderShapes, _ = selectRenderShapes(result, nil, RenderShapeOptions{InvestmentThemeShare: true})
	result.Completeness = ComputeAnswerCompleteness(result)
	return result
}

// cmd/zztreemap/main.go
// Scratch only (CHAOS-12496): the real selector, flag on, then the real encoder.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/full-chaos/dev-health-acr/internal/contextfabric"
)

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

func main() {
	result := contextfabric.ZZTreemapResult([]float64{0.4821, 0.2264, 0.17535475272593534, 0.11614524727406466, 0})
	raw, err := os.ReadFile("contracts/examples/v1/context_fabric_investigation_result_render_shapes.v1.json")
	must(err)
	var example contextfabric.InvestigationResult
	must(json.Unmarshal(raw, &example))
	result.Versions = example.Versions
	served, tier := contextfabric.ServeVocabularyLabels(result, true, 262144)
	must(served.Validate())
	encoded, err := json.MarshalIndent(served, "", "    ")
	must(err)
	must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Args[1], "investment-treemap.json"), append(encoded, '\n'), 0o644))
	fmt.Printf("tier=%s shapes=%d bytes=%d\n", tier, len(served.RenderShapes), len(encoded))
}
